Scope: these rules concern laundry/utility rooms in homes (washroom 'laundry/utility room'); fine but keep '洗衣/家务间'.

issues: Condition dropped: placing artificially lit bathrooms in the central zone is stated only for 'buildings of greater depth' where the central area is widened into a subsidiary-space zone (p.145); summary generalises it to any flat plan.
corrected_summary: 卫生间宜朝北，尽可能自然采光通风，否则按 DIN 18017-3 设置有效的机械通风；在进深较大的建筑中，户型中部可加宽为辅助功能区，人工照明（或经其他区域间接采光）的卫生间可布置于此。
evidence_note: p.160 'should be oriented to the north ... (otherwise provide effective mechanical ventilation according to DIN 18017-3)'; p.145 'In buildings of greater depth, the central area ... Bathrooms with artificial lighting ... can be placed here'.

title: 婴儿车与自行车公共储藏间
issues: The gloss '如两户以上' is imported from a waste-storage passage in the Agriculture chapter (p.464), which reads 'more than two flats or a usable area of 400 m² (building classes 3–5)'; the gloss is incomplete (drops the 400 m² alternative) and not part of the storeroom passage. Remove it or quote fully.
Summary omits that the book also says corresponding areas should be provided in other residential buildings and detached houses (optional).
corrected_summary: 建筑法规要求建筑等级 3–5 的住宅设置方便到达的（公共）婴儿车、童车和自行车储藏间（其他住宅和独立住宅也宜设相应空间）；设计时可按每位住户（含儿童）至少一辆车估算；储藏间宜尽量设在街道层，可上锁，并配挂钩和自行车架。
evidence_note: p.165 'for residential buildings in building classes 3–5, the building regulations require an easily accessible (communal) storeroom...'; 'at least one vehicle per occupant'; 'if possible ... at street level, be lockable'.

title: 办公室净高
issues: The 3.00 m guideline for working rooms >100 m² comes from the Industry and trade chapter (p.266, industrial buildings), not from the office section — generalised to offices.
2.75 m is stated as 'according to Vst regulation' (and to allow later raised floors/suspended ceilings); the regulation source is dropped.
2.30 m for corridors and sanitary facilities is 'permitted' — fine, but should be kept as office-building context (p.243 two-row office buildings).
corrected_summary: 办公楼（按 Vst 规定）室内净高 2.75 m（便于日后加设架空地板和较深吊顶）；以坐姿工作为主时可降低 25 cm，但净高不低于 2.50 m；走廊和卫生设施允许为 2.30 m。（另：工业与工商建筑一章给出面积大于 100 m² 的工作间净高参考值 3.00 m。）
evidence_note: p.243 'Ceiling height 2.75 m according to Vst regulation ... min. 2.50 m clear. Corridors and sanitary facilities are permitted to be 2.30 m'; p.266 (Industry) 'guideline 3.00 m for working rooms larger than 100 m^2'.

title: 每工位总面积

corrected_summary: 桌面工作面积宜不小于 120 × 80 cm（文件少、以屏幕工作为主的情况；专业人员至少 200 × 80 cm）；每个工位宜有不小于 1.5 m² 的自由活动面积。

title: 工作场所厕所（劳动场所规定）
issues: Condition dropped: the 'one storey height' limit applies 'if no escalator is available'.
Context is the Industry and trade chapter (workplaces generally), not specifically offices — acceptable under 'workplace regulations' title but the topic label 办公 is broader than source.
corrected_summary: （工作场所）厕所距每个工位不超过 100 m，或最远不超过一层楼高（无自动扶梯时）；员工超过 5 人须分设男女厕所，且宜仅供员工使用；厕所由带洗手盆的前室（每 5 个 WC 至少 1 个洗手盆）和完全分隔、至少含一个 WC 的房间组成。
evidence_note: p.270 'not more than 100 m or, at the farthest, one storey height (if no escalator is available)'; 'more than five employees, separate toilets must be provided'; 'lobby with washbasins (at least one washbasin per five WCs)'.

title: 档案室
issues: '密集架取高值' is an interpretation not in the text: the book gives 7.5–12.5 kN/m² '(for mobile units)' as an increased floor loading for archive rooms, without saying mobile units take the upper value.
'须设计' vs 'should be designed' — use 应/宜 for the loading.
corrected_summary: 文件室须干燥，因此不宜设在阁楼和地下室；文件存放区净高 2.10 m（2 层普通办公 = 3 层文件存放）；档案室宜按 7.5–12.5 kN/m² 的较高楼面荷载设计（针对移动式密集架）。
evidence_note: p.237 'ceiling clearance height 2.10 m (2 storeys of normal office space = 3 storeys of filing). The rooms must be dry, so attic and cellar are inadvisable'; p.238 'Archive rooms should be designed for an increased floor loading of 7.5–12.5 kN/m² (for mobile units)'.

title: 酒店星级与客房面积
issues: The areas are DEHOGA minimum areas that apply to 75% of the hotel rooms (1–2 stars explicitly; 3–5 stars 'see above'); summary omits 'minimum' and the 75% qualifier.
1-star rooms are explicitly 'without bathroom' (washbasin in room); 2-star area includes bathroom and corridor — omitted.
Scope: classification of the German Hotel and Inn Association (DEHOGA), not an official German regulation — '德国酒店分级' acceptable but better name DEHOGA.
corrected_summary: 按德国酒店餐饮协会（DEHOGA）分级，单人间/双人间最小面积（适用于 75% 的客房）：1 星 8/12 m²（不含卫生间，房内设洗手盆）；2 星 12/16 m²（含卫生间和走道，70% 客房带卫生间）；3 星 14/18 m²（全部客房带卫生间）；4 星 16/22 m²；5 星 18/26 m²。
evidence_note: p.172 '1 Star: single room 8 m², double room 12 m² (minimum area for 75% of the hotel rooms, without bathroom) ... 2 Stars ... (minimum area for 75% ..., including bathroom and corridor), bathroom in room (for 70%) ... 3 Stars ... bathroom in room (for all rooms)'.
